title: Ivrii conjecture on periodic billiard orbits
exact_target: In every bounded smooth Euclidean billiard domain, do regular periodic trajectories occupy zero Liouville measure in the boundary phase space?

sources.citation: Alexey Glutsyuk, On 4-reflective complex analytic planar billiards, arXiv:1405.5990v4 (17 December 2015); standard real billiard-map conventions as in Hassell-Zelditch, arXiv:math/0211140, Section 3.
